capture.question_verbatim: Is the utility-scale storage theme attractive through its named universe? (INVENTED FIXTURE)

falsifiers.description: Quarterly storage installations stop growing against the prior year. (INVENTED FIXTURE)
The storage investment credit is repealed. (INVENTED FIXTURE)

theme.thesis: Utility-scale storage deployments compound for a decade as grids absorb renewable generation. (INVENTED FIXTURE)

requirements.description: Is the subject earning more than a year ago? (INVENTED FIXTURE)
requirements.gap_reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - a theme has no single income statement; the equity fact families are absent by design at the theme level
requirements.weakened_test: profit growth cannot anchor conviction; the falsifier and deployment facts carry the thesis instead

requirements.description: How much cash does the subject generate after unavoidable spending? (INVENTED FIXTURE)
requirements.gap_reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - a theme has no single cash-flow statement; the fact family is absent by design at the theme level
requirements.weakened_test: the cash-generation leg of the case is empty; the named members' own facts stand in for it

requirements.description: Is the price expensive or cheap against the subject's own history or peers? (INVENTED FIXTURE)
requirements.gap_reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - no single rating exists for a theme; there is nothing to divide one price by
requirements.weakened_test: the rating read lives per named member, and it is weaker than a single-name rating

requirements.description: Does the earnings or cash yield beat the risk-free rate? (INVENTED FIXTURE)
requirements.gap_reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - a theme pays nothing as a theme; there is no yield to compare
requirements.weakened_test: the comparison against the risk-free rate is one-sided by design; the cost of waiting in bills is the whole reading

requirements.description: The deployment backlog Grid Storage Alpha load-bears on for this theme. (INVENTED FIXTURE)
